observations: Photo 0 shows a wooden open-shelf wardrobe/cabinet unit with multiple cubby compartments on the left and center, filled with folded clothes.
Right side has a hanging rod with garments on hangers, partially open to view.
No doors are visible on the front of the unit, consistent with 'open wardrobe' style.
Floor around the unit is cluttered with loose clothes, a red stool or crate, and what looks like a broom leaning against the wall.
Wood surface condition (scratches, stains, warping) is largely obscured by stored items.
No close-up of joints, shelves, or the base is provided.

claims.claim: It's an open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows an open-front shelving/hanging unit consistent with home or boutique display use
no receipt, date stamp, or purchase proof visible
wood surfaces are mostly covered by stored clothes in photo 0; cannot inspect for stains or cracks
no foam component is visible on an open wardrobe; claim appears to be boilerplate text possibly copied from another listing type (e.g. sofa/mattress ad)
cannot be confirmed from a photo

risks.risk: Hidden wood damage, scratches, or water stains under the stored clothes
risks.proof: A clear photo of the empty, cleared-out wardrobe showing all shelves and the hanging rail
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly used/worn, not as new

risks.risk: Structural weakness in shelves or hanging rod (sagging under load)
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the rod holding full weight of hangers, and shelves without items to check for sagging
risks.if_unproven: priced as average condition, not as sturdy/new

risks.risk: Mismatched claim ('foam still firm') suggests a copy-pasted description, raising doubt about how carefully the rest of the listing was written
risks.proof: A revised, item-specific description or photo set from the seller without template language
risks.if_unproven: treated as a minor credibility flag, not disqualifying, but claims about condition are discounted accordingly

proof_requests: Photo of the wardrobe fully cleared of clothes, showing all shelves, back panel, and hanging rod
Close-up photos of corners, joints, and the base for wood damage or cracks
A short video showing the unit's stability when lightly pushed or when the hanging rod is loaded
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an open wardrobe/shelving unit, and even though several seller claims (newness, no damage, smoke-free home) are unverifiable from the single cluttered photo, this does not block pricing: it is priced at worst case (as used/unverified condition) against comparable open wardrobe listings in Oyo.
